licenceBasis: Existing approved Overture ODbL branch (docs/research/overture-source.md), USGS public-domain and OSM ODbL; explicit /properties/height lineage required. Unknown lineage excluded.
floorHeightSource: Existing heights.json#floors.perFloor; no fitting to this evaluation. Roof height is required separately.
overhangDefinition: Vendor vegetation classes 3-5 within footprint: >=20 returns and >=5% of surface returns. Proxy only; these labels are not used to clean DSM predictions, so Denver class-1 input uses the same estimator.
methodNote: Predeclared general baseline: 1 m per-cell surface p95 minus inverse-distance class-2 ground; building p95 of differences. All surface classes 1,3,4,5,6 retained. No fitted offsets or threshold tuning. These experimental estimator parameters are not validated accuracy claims.
